A girl at one with the forces of nature, innocent and beautiful. Every arrow from her bow radiates the blessings of the forest. Acting upon her master's orders, she embarked on a journey to explore the world around her, and in the process, fell in love with the heroic Xiang Yu. However, she was warned by her senior, Liang, that the person she had fallen in love with was the dark master from the prophecies. Brokenhearted and resigned to her fate, Consort Yu's arrow had already tragically pierced her lover's heart when the illusion of the being disguised as Liang wore off. How will this fateful love tragedy end, and what should the despairing Consort Yu do?

skills.description: Select a teammate: Dashes to the target, then shelters them, granting both himself and the teammate a shield. The teammate controls both heroes' movement during this time. skills.name: Sacred Tree Blessing
skills.description: Cleanses himself of all crowd control effects, deals physical damage to nearby enemies, and gains max Health. While this skill is active, Skill 2 and enhanced Basic Attacks unleash sword energy. He also continuously gains enhanced Basic Attacks. Tap again to end the skill.

pick_when: Your draft needs a Fighter who can play Clash Lane or Jungle and stay relevant through sustained trades.
The enemy team has to fight you in melee range, giving Fatih time to cycle skills into enhanced basic attacks.
Your team can use Fatih as a side-lane pressure point while he scales into item-dependent duels.
avoid_when: The enemy composition can kite from range and deny Fatih repeated basic attacks after each skill cast.
You need immediate long-range initiation rather than a melee sustain fighter who ramps through repeated trades.
The enemy team can stack anti-heal or burst him before Sacred Tree Blessing and lifesteal can turn the fight.
power_spikes: Early lane or jungle: public guide data recommends prioritizing Skill 1 to improve early combat ability.
Ultimate available: Sacred Tree Blessing lets Fatih remove crowd control, gain max health, and improve Skill 2 plus enhanced basic attacks.
Core damage items online: Axe of Torment, Eternity Blade, Master Sword, Shadow Ripper, and Bloodweeper push him toward stronger extended fights.
common_mistakes: Using skills without weaving enhanced basic attacks, which wastes Fatih's main recovery and damage pattern.
Casting Sacred Tree Blessing before enemy control is committed instead of using it as a turn tool.
Building only damage when the matchup requires Eye of the Phoenix or Spikemail-style durability.
Forcing short burst trades when Fatih's value is strongest in prolonged melee fights.

pick_when: Pick Florentino when your team needs a mobile Clash Lane duelist who can pressure isolated targets and sustain through precise combos.
avoid_when: Avoid Florentino when the enemy draft has layered crowd control or reliable ranged disengage that prevents him from collecting bouquets.

skills.description: Removes all debuffs from self and becomes untargetable. Damages enemies in range, leaving behind a sword formation. Enemies that touch the edge of the formation are damaged, slowed, and sundered.

skills.description: Transforms into a phantom, continuously slashing at the specified area. Removes all debuffs and becomes untargetable while the skill is active. Deals area damage, but damage is diminished upon hitting multiple enemy heroes.

pick_when: The enemy team has carries with limited self-peel that Li Bai can reach before the team can react
Your team can engage first, letting Li Bai second-wave into low-health targets
The enemy draft includes Dun, Lian Po, and Liu Shan, who appear in counter data as matchups Li Bai can pressure.
avoid_when: Enemy peel is strong and Li Bai cannot reach the backline without dying first
Your team has no primary engage, leaving the cleanup pick with nothing to follow up on
The enemy already drafted Garo, Mozi, and Shi, who counter data identifies as direct answers to Li Bai.
power_spikes: Early game: jungle clear into level-4 ganks is the first window where Li Bai can translate routes into kills.
Ultimate unlocked: Flickering Flurry converts mobility into burst, the moment Li Bai starts threatening picks across the map
Late game: full build online, Li Bai reaches the spike public guides describe — extended fights favor him once items are completed.
common_mistakes: Engaging without follow-up — gap-close gets you to the target, but a solo dive without ally damage trades 1-for-1.
Engaging first instead of second — cleanup picks lose their value as primary engagers.
Ignoring Garo and Mozi on the enemy team when picking fights — counter data flags them as direct answers, so engage timing must respect their cooldowns.
Pathing predictably and getting tracked by the enemy jungler — vary first clear and rotate based on ward placement rather than muscle memory.

matchups.evidence: Li Bai's dashes reach Lorion faster than Darkness Falls can reposition him.
The barrier knocks back and stuns Li Bai as he dashes in, breaking his combo.

Protecting Winds blocks Li Bai's physical burst, letting her shoot back safely.
Convergence knocks Li Bai back as he dashes in.
